name: Ribbed Ceramic Table Lamp with Linen Drum Shade
description: A table lamp with a fluted, vertically ribbed ceramic base in warm cream glaze, brass-toned hardware, and a plain natural linen drum shade.
materials: Glazed fluted stoneware/ceramic base, brass-toned metal harp and neck fittings, natural linen drum shade over a plain frame.
primaryColors: Warm cream ceramic base, natural linen-white shade, brass-toned accents
negativeConstraints: Never render any text, logo, or printed pattern on the linen shade or ceramic base; never add a decorative motif to the fluting; keep hardware plain and unbranded.
preservationNotes: Keep the same fluted bulbous-to-tapered ceramic base shape, brass-toned harp/neck fitting, and plain unprinted linen drum shade proportions consistent across all five angles.
